messages:
Yna Park: Hey team! I’m Yna Park, starting today as SWE on Platform. Excited to join. Quick Qs — I’m on a company M1 Mac; who should I ping for imaging + VPN? Also, is there a buddy for the week? :wave:
Rajiv Mehta: Welcome Yna!! Rajiv here. Zoe will be your buddy this week, she’ll DM you about pairing. For imaging, ping @it-bot in #help or DM IT. We’ll schedule a 30m sync at 3pm PT to kick off. :tada:
Zoe Liu: Hey Yna :raised_hands: — I’ll DM you Slack and we can do a quick screenshare to get your dev box set up. What time zone are you in?
Yna Park: PST. 3pm PT works. Also asking about sudo access for local dev containers — is that infra or me?
Sam W: Sudo/keys: can likely be approved by infra. @Zoe Liu can add you to the infra-dev group, then you should be able to run `sudo` for container tasks. I’ll add a note to your onboarding ticket.
IT Bot: it-bot: New ticket created #IT-7892 for imaging and VPN provisioning. ETA 2 business days. If urgent, reply `priority: high`.
Zoe Liu: I’ll set up a pairing session at 3pm PT. Also, if you want stickers and keyboard preference, ping Marta in people-ops.
Marta (People Ops): Welcome! We just shipped your laptop kit — should arrive today. If you’d like a mechanical keyboard (Keychron) let me know. Also send sticker requests here :stickers:
Yna Park: Ooh Keychron yes please. Also, SSH setup — I saw the guide but stuck on `ssh-add`. Quick snippet I used: ```ssh-add -K ~/.ssh/id_ed25519``` Getting `Could not open a connection to your authentication agent`.
Rajiv Mehta: Try `eval "$(ssh-agent -s)"` then `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519`. On macOS with Keychain use the `-K` flag. If still failing, Zoe and I can screenshare after 3pm.
Zoe Liu: Also pro tip: install Rosetta for some deps: `/usr/sbin/softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license` — we’ll walk through dev container tweaks.
Yna Park: Thanks all! Looking forward to pairing and meeting everyone. Fun fact: used to be a morning barista for 2 yrs — coffee recs incoming :coffee:
